name: FVG continuation m15 (NET of spread)
note: SURVIVES COSTS: gross +0.4075, measured spread costs 0.1824R/trade, net +0.2252, headroom 2.2x. 288 trades/yr = ~+65R/yr net, against the live system's ~107 fills/yr. The ONLY model whose edge stays positive after costs at 5/5 folds. Edge DECAYS with timeframe: +0.2249 m15, +0.1095 h1, -0.3261 h4 - the signal lives on the low timeframe. CAUTION: control is positive (+0.1827), so a large share of raw R is the 2022-2026 trending regime; 23.6% WR with a 17-loss worst run; headroom 2.2x is thin once commission, swap and slippage are added.

name: Swing trend pullback h4 (REJECTED)
note: RUN ON 4H AS ASKED, and it is the best version by every RAW measure: +0.2296 R/trade, spread costs only 0.0162R, headroom 14.2x, net +0.2135. REJECTED ANYWAY: the matched control beats it by 0.62R/trade, and the deficit GROWS with timeframe (-0.045 m15, -0.421 h1, -0.622 h4). The trend DIRECTION pays in this sample; the pullback TIMING destroys value. Also the first run returned 0 trades on h1/h4 because the scan window was narrower than its own start offset - a harness bug, not a market fact.

name: CRT+FVG+EMA reclaim (NET of spread)
note: SUPERSEDES the gross row: +0.1718 gross becomes +0.0513 net once the measured spread (0.1206R/trade on m15 stops) is charged. Headroom 1.4x, which is inside the band where commission, swap and slippage can close the gap on their own - so it is NOT a pass. Best EDGE over control of anything measured (+0.4804) and 5/5 folds; the problem is the stop size, not the setup.
